messages.subject: shiny/httpuv installation on OpenBSD
parts:
Hi everyone,
It is nice to have opportunity to join this group.

Is it possible to install shiny on OpenBSD?

install.packages('shiny') tries to install httpuv first. Unfortunately httpuv installation fails with following error message:

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
  unable to load shared object '/home/USER/R/x86_64-unknown-openbsd5.7-library/3.1/httpuv/libs/httpuv.so':
  Cannot load specified object
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
ERROR: loading failed
* removing '/home/USER/R/x86_64-unknown-openbsd5.7-library/3.1/httpuv'
ERROR: dependency 'httpuv' is not available for package 'shiny'
* removing '/home/USER/R/x86_64-unknown-openbsd5.7-library/3.1/shiny'

Any idea?
Thanks,
TM
